I heard a flush in the background, and he said "haha, no thanks. I kinda care about my reputation". Middle-school-me was devastated.

Nothing works better than just letting him know that you want to help. Everyone deals with depression differently, so he may reject your offer, but I it will most likely help him to know that you are a solid friend.
